guidetextdraw._value:
INSTRUCTIONS:
Fill in the information about the people that your parents will support between July 1, 2021 and June 30, 2022. See definition of
parent below. Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will
delay processing.
guidetextdraw.name: textOne

guidetextdraw_203999_926182577._value:
INCLUDE:
-    yourself (list yourself on the first line),
-    your parent(s), and
-    your parents' dependent children (if they receive more than half of their support from your parents, or if they would be
     required to provide parental information when applying for state student aid).
guidetextdraw_203999_926182577.name: textTwo

guidetextdraw_102283._value:
OTHER PEOPLE MAY BE INCLUDED ONLY IF THEY:
- lived with and received more than half of their support from your parents at the time you completed your (CDA) and
- will continue to receive this support between July 1, 2021 and June 30, 2022.
guidetextdraw_102283.name: textdraw_10228399051644405829136

guidetextdraw_copy._value:
TELL US ABOUT YOUR FAMILY SIZE
List all family members that meet the definition listed above. In addition, check yes for each family member listed, other than parents,
who are enrolled in six (6) or more units that can be applied toward a college degree or certificate program (parent educational
expenses are not considered). Attach a separate sheet if you need more space.
guidetextdraw_copy.name: textOne_copy_1

table_copy.name: CDATable

guidetextdraw_1022839905.text:
OTHER PEOPLE MAY BE INCLUDED ONLY IF THEY:
-   lived with and received more than half of their support from you or your spouse at the time you completed your
    California Dream Act Application
    AND
-   will continue to receive this support between July 1, 2022 and June 30, 2023.

guidetextdraw_203999.text:
Definition of parent: For the CDA, “parent” refers to your biological and/ or adoptive parents (including your step-parent if that
person is currently married to your “parent”).
The following are NOT considered to be a “legal parent” for the CDA:

  • Grandparents, foster parents, legal guardians, aunts and uncles are NOT considered parents unless they have
    legally adopted you.
  • Any person who is not married to your parent and who is not a legal or biological parent

If your parent’s CDA marital status is “married,” or “unmarried and both parents living together,” then both their information
must be provided
